scripts.build: npm exec --yes --package @napi-rs/cli -- napi build --platform --release && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=__dirname,f=fs.readdirSync(d).find(x=>x.endsWith('.node')&&x.includes('win32'));if(f){fs.copyFileSync(p.join(d,f),p.join(d,'wad_indexer.node'));console.log('Copied',f,'-> wad_indexer.node')}"
